import std.file as f
import std.bytes as b
import std.gc as gc
fn main(){let h=unwrap(f.open("data","w+"))
let alias=h
gc.collect()
f.write(alias,b.from_text("Hua"))
print(is_ok(f.close(h)),unwrap(f.state(alias)))}
